{{Top|leg}}
The '''MasterNav''', formally known as the '''MasterNav Software Module Gamma''',<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] navigational database developed to allow military forces to infiltrate enemy territory close to their intended target. This allowed for safer missions and gave the forces an element of surprise.
